 Serie A October 18th 2026 The Rossoneri are back at home for Serie A Matchday 9 . AC Milan vs. Bologna kicks off at 6:30 PM CET, with the following official line-ups: 
 AC MILAN (4-4-1-1) : Maignan; Tomori, De Winter, Pavlović, Estupiñan; Hutchinson, Musah, Jashari, Bartesaghi; Cisse; Ramos. Subs: Bouyer, Torriani; M. Cissé, Diawara, Perera, F. Terracciano, Vladimirov; Comotto, Modrić, Pulisic, Vos; Camarda, Menon, Ossola. Coach: Amorim.
 BOLOGNA (3-4-3) : Skorupski; Darmian, Casale, Theate; Zortea, Pobega, Ferguson, Alhassane; Bernardeschi, Odgaard, Mbangula. Subs: Happonen, Pessina; Heggem, Helland, Miranda, Vitík; Amondarain, El Azzouzi, Libra, Moro; Cambiaghi, Dovbyk, Lo Monaco. Coach: Palladino.
 Referee : Sacchi from Macerata.
